A woman attempts to wave down traffic on the M6, a young driver gets trapped in his car after crashing into the central reservation, and a lorry cab threatens to catch fire on the M5.
Back on the roads with Cheshire Police's elite team of motorway cops, storms and torrential rain bring travel chaos to the roads and PC Mike responds to a call for urgent backup on the night shift.

Dog handler Darren calls on all his powers of persuasions to try and end a rooftop stand-off. Spike breaks out a drug wipe for a teenage tearaway on two wheels, while Steve is forced to use his pepper spray when a suspect refuses to come quietly.

Chris and the team are in pursuit of a stolen Mazda M3, and the driver disappears into an industrial area. Chris' tracker dog Ronny has a twitchy nose, and they hope this canine crime fighter will manage to track down the villain.

A car has broken down on the hard shoulder of the M6. PC Andy Doran is called in to support Highways, as they're unhappy with the driver's behaviour. When he arrives at the location, Andy quickly finds out why.

When Coups and the team get behind a high-performance Mercedes, the driver clocks the cops, goes full throttle up the motorway and careers off road. In Mansfield, Phil Broughton goes undercover to find a van man.

Stop Sticks are used to end a pursuit of a Jeep in South Carolina. A suspect hides in a closet and fights with Officers. A woman caught driving a stolen truck claims she had permission from the owner.

A suspect caught assaulting his girlfriend kicks in the witness's door. A man is stabbed in the head during an argument with neighbours. A female driver refuses to identify herself to avoid jail time.
Mulder is drawn into a dangerous confrontation with creatures that could expose the conspiracy surrounding extraterrestrials.
Documenting the case of 6ft 7 powerhouse Gary Vinter, who has a long history of violence culminating in a frenzied attack on a colleague who he stabbed multiple times and then left to die.
Matt Adams rides a volatile load into a world of trouble with a bull on board. The Kendalls share a family experience of trucking and another haul carries a sting in the tail.
In Berkshire, a convoy of three trucks pick up and deliver a fleet of 15 valuable supercars, ensuring they arrive in precisely the same pristine condition as when they were loaded.
A trawler yacht bought in the USA for just $7, painstakingly refurbished in a Lancashire dock and now valued at a whopping £400,000 needs carefully moving to the Thames.
